title: FeedLike - Data API
description: Indicates that a user has liked a feed item. This object is available in API version 21.0 and later.

FeedItemId.description: ID of the feed item that the user liked.

FeedEntityId.description: The ID of a feed item or feed comment the user liked. If the user liked a comment, FeedEntityId is set to the ID of the comment. If the user liked a feed item, FeedEntityId is set to the ID of the feed item. This field is optional. The default value is the ID of the feed item.

InsertedById.description: ID of the user who added this item to the feed. For example, if an application migrates posts and comments from another application into a feed, the InsertedBy value is set to the ID of the context user. This is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: If the context user has the Insert System Field Values for Chatter Feeds user permission, the create field property is available on CreatedBy and CreatedDate system fields. During migration, the context user can set these fields to the original post’s author and creation date. The fields can’t be updated after migration.
usage:
You can't query FeedLike records directly. They can only be queried via the entity feed, such as AccountFeed. FeedLike records represent likes on posts and not likes on comments. Likes on comments can’t be queried via the API.
